Skate Park City.name: Skate Park City
Skate Park City.summary: Skate Park City draws on the very best elements of the great Tony Hawk and Jet Set Radio series fused with its own unique ingredients to make it the coolest, most creative and downright fun skateboarding game seen on any platform. Available on the Sony PSP you can play it whenever and wherever you want - go skating on the train, in a plane and even create your very own skate park in the city!
